comparison.objective: Route a cable through four clips in order and place its plug in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential cable manipulation, clip insertion, and terminal placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cable is pressed into all four clips left-to-right and the plug ends in the orange tray; numeric seating criteria are absent.
comparison.reason: Sequential deformable routing and clip engagement do not test impact fracture, retained-thread protection, or free-fragment containment.
